902075.text: Iva Jovic to beat Jasmine Paolini. The American is the No. 4 seed in Ningbo and sits 12th in the WTA rankings on 2,931 points, roughly double Paolini's 1,453 at No. 35. Jovic won the Guadalajara title in September, beating Peyton Stearns 6-4 6-2 in the final, and then reached the last 16 in both Beijing and Wuhan. Paolini did get past Anhelina Kalinina 6-2 7-5 here on Tuesday, but she took only two games off Sonay Kartal in Wuhan last week. We make Jovic a -188 shot; the market price shown was -200, inside the window.

534841.text: San Antonio Spurs to beat the Houston Rockets. San Antonio finished 2025-26 at 62-20, second in the West, and went 32-8 in home games, while Houston were 52-30 overall but only 22-19 on the road. The Rockets did open this season with a 128-110 win over Dallas on Wednesday and closed last year 9-1 in their final ten, so this is no walkover. One quirk worth knowing: NBA.com lists this Spurs home game at the Moody Center in Austin, so we halved our normal home edge. Fair price -162; the market showed -250.

160789.text: Milwaukee Brewers to win Game 1 of the World Series. The Brewers had the stronger regular season by some distance, 103-59 with a +214 run differential against Tampa Bay's 98-64 and +86, and they went 55-26 at American Family Field. They then swept the Dodgers in the NLCS, 2-1, 7-4, 6-2 and 6-4. MLB lists Jacob Misiorowski as Milwaukee's probable starter; the Rays had not named theirs when we captured the feed, and they needed six games to get past Cleveland. Fair -161 against a market -163.

32325.text: Gerwyn Price to beat Rob Cross in Dortmund. This is a rematch of the 2019 European Championship final, and Cross has won this title twice, but the current numbers lean clearly one way: Price is fourth on the PDC Order of Merit, Cross 22nd. The PDC's own player records credit Price with 45 senior titles, nine of them Premier events, against 22 and four for Cross. It is the fourth tie of Thursday's evening session. Our fair price is -235 and the market showed -175.
